reasons.claim: 3.22 ha regeneration felling notification, status notified. Completed felling overlaps only 1.8% of the polygon (0.057 ha), far below the 50% needed for ALREADY_FELLED.
No species records of any kind lie inside the polygon or within 250 m, and the 250 m ring has no eligible species. Near-site effort is 0 records there, which matches the county median of 0.

12 eligible species (threatened, forest-associated, felling-relevant, site-bound) are recorded beyond 250 m but within 1000 m. The nearest records are 717-931 m away, including EN Gomphus clavatus (751 m), EN Ramaria brunneicontusa (758 m), EN Hydnellum lundellii (763 m) and VU Cortinarius cupreorufus (717 m, 2025). Many records date from 2023-2025. This meets the rubric's MEDIUM rule.
Effort around the site is adequate (251 records within 1000 m vs county median 113.5, 75th percentile).

uncertainties: The threatened species are 700 m or more away, and no records fall within 250 m, so their relevance to the stand is unclear.
The cluster of records seems concentrated at one location around 720-760 m away, so may reflect one well-surveyed locality rather than the wider landscape; the tools do not state this.
Near-site effort is zero records, so no records within 250 m could mean no one surveyed there as well as nothing found.
not_established: That any threatened species occurs in or next to the polygon.
That the stand shares habitat with the locations of these records.
Absence of records near the site does not show that species are absent.
next_action: Have a reviewer check the stand against the cluster of EN/VU fungus records 700-900 m away, for example by comparing habitat and connectivity on a map, and decide whether a field visit is warranted before felling starts.
